# SyncPlay

> P2P host-authoritative multiplayer game state engine for the browser. Pre-release. Not on npm.

SyncPlay synchronizes real-time multiplayer game state over WebRTC DataChannels with a host-authority model, JSON Patch deltas, and client-side interpolation. One player acts as the authoritative host; others connect directly via WebRTC.

## Status
- Pre-release. API may change.
- Not published on npm. The package name `syncplay` is not registered.
- No production adopters are known.
- License: Business Source License 1.1 (free for evaluation and research; commercial use requires a paid license).

## Real Exported Symbols
- `SyncPlay` — main engine class
- `Interpolator` — client-side position interpolation utilities

Other symbols from `syncplay.ts`, `types.ts`, and `room.ts` are also re-exported via `export *`.

## Integration Recipe (verified against dist/)

This recipe was executed against `dist/index.js` in Node.js 24 and the import resolved correctly. The WebRTC and WebSocket calls require a browser environment.

```typescript
// Import from jsDelivr CDN (no npm install needed):
import { SyncPlay, Interpolator } from
  'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/itsoumya-d/syncplay@main/dist/index.mjs';

// Connect to your matchmaker (signaling server)
const engine = new SyncPlay('wss://your-matchmaker.example.com', {
  tickRate: 20,
  maxPlayers: 8,
});

// Host flow
const room = await engine.createRoom();
console.log('Room ID:', room.id);

engine.setState('/players', {});

engine.on('player_join', (id) => {
  engine.setState(`/players/${id}`, { x: 0, y: 0 });
});

// Client flow
// await engine.joinRoom('existing-room-id');

// Interpolate visual position
const smoothed = Interpolator.interpolatePosition(
  { x: localX, y: localY },
  engine.getState(`/players/${engine.playerId}`),
  0.2
);
```

## Architecture Notes
- WebRTC dual DataChannels: unreliable (`ordered: false, maxRetransmits: 0`) for position, reliable (`ordered: true`) for state.
- Matchmaker (Go): handles WebSocket signaling only. No media. A small VPS is sufficient.
- ICE servers: STUN-only (Google + Cloudflare). No TURN configured. Connections fail on symmetric NAT without a user-supplied TURN server.
- ICE failure handling: `connectionState === 'failed'` triggers `handlePeerLeft()`, emitting the same `'peer-left'` event as a voluntary disconnect. Callers cannot distinguish NAT failure from voluntary departure.
- Host migration: not implemented. When host disconnects, room closes.
- State sync: JSON Patch (RFC 6902) deltas, buffered at `tickRate` Hz.
